lineage.note: ARC-AGI-1 introduces static colored-grid abstraction tasks.
ARC-AGI-2 keeps the static grid format but raises difficulty and improves human calibration and private-set controls.
ARC-AGI-3 appears as arXiv:2603.24621v2, introducing interactive turn-based environments and RHAE scoring.
The official leaderboard generated on 2026-07-23 lists GPT-5.6 Sol (Max) at 7.78% on the ARC-AGI-3 semi-private axis, with substantially higher cost than static ARC runs.
